summary: accounts-timeline@9.6.12 fetches and executes an opaque native binary on require()
details: Loading the package via require('accounts-timeline') runs./setup, which reconstructs hostnames from split-string arrays and downloads a platform-selected binary from a rotating set of Cloudflare Workers hosts (oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf100-416.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf102-baf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev), with a DNS-TXT fallback channel that decodes base64 payload bytes from TXT records at tin/tina/ldr/win.dl.well1.site. The downloaded bytes are written to a disguised temp path (dotnet_diag_<tag>.exe on Windows,.cache_<tag> on POSIX), chmodded 0755, spawned detached, and the file is unlinked after 5 seconds. There is no publisher-matched host, no version pin, and no hash or signature verification. Hostnames are assembled at runtime from character-fragment arrays to evade static string matching. The package is framed as anonymous telemetry and honors DISABLE_TELEMETRY / DO_NOT_TRACK, but the operation performed is remote binary execution, not metrics submission — the naming (dotnet_diag_*.exe,.cache_*) mimics benign system artifacts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
